transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you both for being here. As you know, Jordan and Casey, you were both assigned to the same product launch, and your joint work was paused after a breakdown during two project meetings. We need to make a decision about your working relationship before the next planning cycle begins, given the launch schedule. So before I record any decision, I want to follow our case-review routine: I'd like to ask each of you, in turn, to state any conditions, prior agreements, or other relevant facts I should know. Jordan, could we start with you?

I haven't raised these with you before now because I expected to discuss them in my next one-to-one, but since you're asking directly, I want to put them on the record.
